newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi to make car parts in Britain.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi to make car parts in Britain.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd said on Wednesday that it set up a subsidiary in Britain last month to manufacture car parts.
The new firm, Hitachi Automotive Products Europe Ltd, is capitalised at eight million sterling. Hitachi owns 75 percent in the firm while Hitachi Europe Ltd owns the rest.
The new firm plans to make air flow sensors and other parts for Japanese car makers operating in Britain.
The new company aims for annual sales of 30 million sterling in 2000/2001, Hitachi said in a statement.
